title: Cash Surrender Provision of Whole Life Insurance
content:
The owner of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy may surrender the policy for its net cash surrender value.

## Clauses in force

**Signatures.** A full surrender is processed only on a surrender request signed by the owner, and also by every irrevocable beneficiary and any collateral assignee of record. The authority is the surrender request on file for the policy, with its signed date, as the system record shows it.

**Effective date.** The surrender is effective on the date the signed request is received.

**Taxable amount and withholding.** The taxable amount is the gross cash value less the cost basis, never below zero. Federal tax is withheld at the tier's default withholding rate of the taxable amount, rounded to the cent, unless the owner elected no withholding on the request.

**Payment and deferral.** Ashgrove pays within its normal processing time but may defer payment for up to the tier's longest surrender deferral as the contract permits.

**Finality.** A surrender cannot be revoked once the policy is surrendered.

**Maturity.** At the maturity age the policy endows and the net cash value is paid the same way.

## Retired clause

The former clause defining the gross cash value as the guaranteed cash value plus the paid-up additions cash value from the most recent anniversary statement plus dividend accumulations, and the net cash surrender value as that gross cash value less the loan balance and loan interest accrued to the effective date, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Ashgrove basis for the net cash surrender value paid on a full surrender.

## Signature test

| Signed by | Irrevocable beneficiary of record | Collateral assignee of record | Surrender processed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Owner | None | None | Yes |
| Owner and the irrevocable beneficiary | One | None | Yes |
| Owner only | One | None | No |
| Owner and the irrevocable beneficiary | One | One, not signed | No |

## Worked figures (hypothetical, withholding rate 10%)

- Gross cash value 52000.00, cost basis 40000.00: taxable amount 12000.00, withholding 1200.00.
- Gross cash value 38000.00, cost basis 40000.00: taxable amount nothing (never below zero), withholding nothing.
- A signed request received on May 14 makes the surrender effective on May 14, whatever the date it was signed.

superseded_clauses: The gross cash value is the guaranteed cash value plus the paid-up additions cash value from the most recent anniversary statement plus dividend accumulations; the net cash surrender value is the gross cash value less the loan balance and loan interest accrued to the effective date.
